job.title: Toyota Care Team Leader
job.description:
Toyota Care Team Leader

Help lead the team at the heart of our customer experience. This is a hands-on role for an experienced leader who knows how to run a high-performing team and bring out the best in their people through a values-led and metric-focused approach.

Get To Know Us

Manukau Toyota Group has been part of the South and South-East Auckland community for more than 35 years. We’re New Zealand-owned, proudly connected to the communities we serve, and serious about creating customer experiences that earn long-term loyalty.

The Role

Help lead ToyotaCare’s day-to-day contact centre operations. You’ll stay close to the floor, monitoring queues, allocating leads, managing outbound dialler activity, balancing workshop demand across our branches, and stepping in when a customer conversation needs experienced support.

This isn’t a leadership role from the sidelines. You’ll coach live, hold clear standards, keep the team moving towards KPIs, and create an environment where people know what good looks like and feel supported to deliver it.

What You’ll Own

  • Drive Culture & Performance: Build and drive a vibrant, high-energy floor culture where fun and focus go hand in hand. Champion the team’s success through strong, consistent, and visible people leadership, inspiring agents to stay engaged, motivated, and aligned with hitting daily volume and targets.
  • Command Floor Operations: Oversee live queues, shared inboxes and outbound campaigns to deliver swift, seamless, and high-quality customer touchpoints.
  • Lift Frontline Performance: Monitor SLAs, abandonment rates, speed of answer, FCR, booking conversions, and data hygiene whilst taking proactive action the moment results drift from target.
  • Deliver Real-Time Coaching: Lead frontline development through side-by-side coaching, live call monitoring, interactive 1-on-1s, quality reviews, and structured fortnightly training to build a highly skilled, confident team.
  • Optimise Group Workshop Capacity: Balance live inbound demand and outbound campaign priorities to maximise and actively fill daily available workshop hours across all branches.
  • Champion Data Integrity: Ensure the flawless capture of customer/vehicle details, historical records, active warranties, TNZ campaigns and WOF updates, while maintaining absolute job card accuracy.
  • Handle the Hard Stuff: Step into complex or sensitive conversations, resolve serious complaints and give agents calm, practical support.
  • Turn Insight into Action: Turn customer feedback, frontline trends, and key CX metrics (NPS, CSAT) into actionable workflow enhancements that continuously elevate the customer experience.
  • Change Leadership: Champion the floor adoption of incoming technology platforms. Drive fast-paced "test-and-learn" initiatives to build smarter workflows eliminating manual friction points to steadily increase output.

What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience leading a contact centre team in a fast paced, KPI driven environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of ACD and telephony systems, queue monitoring, email workflows; outbound dialler and sales experience is a real advantage.
  • A practical coaching style – delivering constructive feedback that maintains trust and rapport while supporting expectations and accountability.
  • An energetic, grounded leadership style that brings focus, consistency and good momentum to the floor.
  • Confidence reading live performance data and turning it into clear priorities for the team.
  • Excellent judgement when handling escalations, competing priorities and fast-moving operational issues.
  • A sharp eye for process, data integrity and follow-through.

What You Can Expect From Us

  • True Growth and Leadership Opportunities: Direct exposure to business transformations and project implementation, giving you a seat at the table to champion ideas and pilot new campaigns. This role offers true leadership development, reinforced by regular, honest feedback channels and high-level management support.
  • Operational Influence: A genuine opportunity to directly shape the performance, daily operations, and growth of the ToyotaCare team.
  • A Winning Team Culture: A highly collaborative environment where we work hard, back one another, and always make space to celebrate our wins.
  • Exclusive Employee Benefits: Staff discounts on WOFs, servicing and vehicle purchases.

If you can command the floor, lift performance and bring out the best in your people, apply now, we’d like to meet you.

Toyota Care Consultant

Work with an iconic brand, for a dealership group that truly values its people, in a team environment that is at its core; High Performing, Fun, Focused and Supportive.

We are looking for 2 Toyota Care Consultants to join the team!

✓ Base Salary Starting from $57,000 (based on experience) + Performance Incentives

✓ Full-time | Botany Location, South Auckland

✓ Career Progression That’s Real – Not Just Talk

Get To Know Us

Manukau Toyota Group (MTG) has been part of the South and South-East Auckland community for over 35 years.

We’re proudly New Zealand-owned, trusted by our customers, and focused on building a team environment that’s full of opportunity and driven to deliver great customer experiences.

The Role

Based at our Botany site, you’ll be the first voice our customers hear when they call in to book a service or repair. You’ll work closely with the service team, handle inbound enquiries (for 60-70% of your time), make outbound calls, and help keep customers on track with their WOF and servicing. The Toyota Care team prides itself on being a high performing, fast paced team that loves to break records, and celebrate our wins together, with food, and more food…

To be successful in this role: You’ll have a ‘can-do’ attitude and love being part of a team, adding value to our culture by just turning up, being present and being yourself!

You’ll thrive in our environment: If you’re someone who’s naturally driven and eager to deliver on all KPI’s, cares about good data integrity, and is solutions focused in your strive to deliver top-tier customer experiences day in and day out.

You will ‘really’ hit the ground running: If you’re also good at upselling, great at managing a call back pipeline, have strong attention to detail and a history of following through.

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in, and we’d love to hear from you!

A Typical Week Consists Of

  • Booking service and repair appointments across our four sites.
  • Maintaining accurate customer records and keeping our data clean, because the details matter!
  • You’ll handle inbound calls, answer general customer questions and resolve issues leaving every customer better off.
  • Towards the later end of the week, you’ll make some outbound calls to customers due for a WOF or service, helping them stay safe and road-ready.
  • A typical day will always include collaborating with our service departments to ensure seamless customer handovers.

You’ll Bring

  • At least 12 months Customer Service or Sales experience preferably in a Contact Centre environment - Automotive experience will be highly regarded.
  • Confidence in your delivery and excellent communication skills.
  • Good time management as you’ll be used to juggling multiple priorities without dropping the ball.
  • A history of using several systems at one time and the ability to pick up new systems quickly
  • An openness to learn new things and a positive, customer-first mindset that’s genuinely part of who you are.

We’ll Deliver On

  • A team culture that is genuinely at its core; Supportive, Fun, and Focused.
  • A base-salary starting from $57,000 (based on experience) plus performance incentives.
  • Monday to Friday (mostly) – Our team work 1 in every 8 Saturdays for 4 hours. That equates to 1 half day Saturday every 2 months, which you are welcome to negotiate with your peers to swap or cover if it’s not for you.
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing training so you can hit the ground running and keep growing.
  • Consistent check-in’s, regular one on ones, coaching and mentoring from your direct line leader and their 1-Up (this is an important part of their day to day).
  • Clear career pathways, with a roadmap to get there. We value those that are engaged and invested. The natural career path is to grow from a Toyota Care Consultant to a Service Advisor, Senior Agent, Team Leader, or Sales Consultant, the choice is yours! We are happy being your ‘foot-in-the-door’ to a successful Automotive career with MTG.
  • An upcoming outbound growth programme to help build upon your Sales career for those who love to close and back themselves to convert.
  • And last but not least; Staff discounts on WOF’s, Servicing and Vehicle Purchases.

If this sounds like you and you want to grow your career working with an iconic brand then apply now - we’d love to hear from you.
